description: Paged list of Corte costituzionale decisions, newest first (anno, numero), with the number of massime of each and the total of matching decisions. Parameters: anno, tipologia (S sentenza, O ordinanza), q (ECLI fragment, e.g. 2017:18), limit (1..100, default 50), offset (default 0). Example: {"anno": 2017, "tipologia": "S", "limit": 20}.
